products.name: HexNest Geometric Planter
products.description: A stackable hexagonal planter system with drainage channels and interlocking edges. Print as a single centerpiece or tile a living wall. Optimized for PLA and PETG; no supports needed in the recommended orientation.

products.name: Emberwing Dragon Mini
products.description: A 32mm-scale dragon miniature with articulated wings and jaw. Designed for resin or FDM with fine detail. Includes pre-supported and unsupported versions for resin printers.

products.name: CableClutch Organizer
products.description: Magnetic-ready cable clips that snap onto desk edges. Includes three sizes for USB-C, HDMI, and power bricks. Print-in-place hinges; no hardware required unless you add optional neodymium magnets.

products.name: Voronoi Glow Shade
products.description: A voronoi-patterned lamp shade that casts intricate shadows. Fits standard E26/E27 pendant sockets via a printed adapter ring. Designed thin for translucency with white PLA or PETG.

products.name: Lumen Spire
products.tagline: A spiral of light for the modern altar.
products.description: Premium desk sculpture — three helical ribbons of sacred geometry around a slender stem crowned by a crystal octahedron. Pearl/aurora PLA recommended. Support-free FDM. ~119.5 mm H × 82 mm footprint · ~14 g PLA · ~2.4 h print

products.name: Spira Bloom
products.tagline: A blush-pink spiral bloom for quiet shelves.
products.description: Bulbous spiral-fluted bud vase with ~20 deep helical ridges twisting from a stable foot to a soft flared scalloped rim. Matte blush-pink / dusty rose PLA look. Organic waves + spirals style. Support-free FDM hollow vessel. ~115 mm H · ~77 mm max dia · ~38 mm base · ~25 mm opening ID · ~45 g PLA · ~6.2 h

products.name: Undula Vessel
products.tagline: Soft waves that feel hand-thrown, not lathed.
products.description: Organic wavy-ridged bud vase — soft bulbous silhouette with ~18 flowing vertical fins that undulate/snake as they rise (not spiral flutes). Hollow, watertight, support-free FDM. ~116 mm H · ~78 mm max · ~39 mm base · ~22–26 mm opening · ~50 g PLA · ~6.9 h

products.name: Coil Shell
products.tagline: A coiled nautilus whisper for quiet shelves.
products.description: Organic nautilus-form sculpture — soft logarithmic spiral (~2.3 whorls), rounded wave ridges on the outer coil, open aperture for a tiny stem/trinket. Support-free FDM with thickened flat foot. Distinct from Spira Bloom / Undula Vessel / Lumen Spire. ~89.9 × 32.9 × 69.5 mm · ~36 g PLA · ~5.0 h

products.name: Aura Loop
products.tagline: A soft Möbius whisper that holds the quiet.
products.description: Organic standing wave-ribbon sculpture — continuous thick ribbon looping once into a Möbius-ish open ring with gentle undulation and a thickened oval foot. Support-free FDM. Distinct from Lumen Spire / Spira Bloom / Undula Vessel / Coil Shell. ~99.6 × 68.0 × 101.5 mm · ~217 g PLA · ~30 h (dense solid)

products.name: BitCarousel Tool Caddy
products.description: A spinning carousel that holds 30+ hex bits with labeled slots. Ball-bearing race is print-in-place; optional steel balls for smoother spin. Desk-friendly footprint under 120mm diameter.

products.name: Planetary Gear Fidget
products.description: A satisfying planetary gear fidget that prints fully assembled. Sun, planet, and ring gears mesh out of the printer. Tune clearances with the included 0.1 / 0.15 / 0.2mm variants.

products.name: FacetCrystal Bud Vase
products.description: A faceted bud vase with watertight interior. Low-poly exterior catches light dramatically. Print solid or vase-mode for a translucent look. Includes drainage-safe insert for fresh flowers.

products.name: ServoFlex Mount Kit
products.description: A kit of brackets, horns, and linkages for common hobby servos. Includes pan-tilt base and rail mounts. Parametric source notes included so you can remix clearances for your brand of servo.
